summary: The footer health text is now green when `apiStatus === 'ok'` and red otherwise (covering both `unavailable` and the pre-response `unknown`), via `is-ok`/`is-error` class bindings in `app.component.html` and matching rules in `app.component.css`. Reading taken: "not ok" = any status other than `ok`. Applied the existing rule that backend health is surfaced as `API: <status>` in the footer — text and fallbacks unchanged.

visual_check.evidence: On /tutorials the footer renders "API: unavailable" in red (#dc2626) via the .is-error class, confirming the non-ok state is colour-coded; the template applies .is-ok (#16a34a green) when apiStatus === 'ok'.

endpoints.purpose: Report backend health; shown in the app footer as 'API: <status>'.

context_sharing.notes: HealthService requests the relative path '/health'; the ApiInterceptor prefixes environment.apiUrl (base '/api'). app.component.ts shows 'unknown' before a response, the raw `status` value when present, and 'unavailable' on any request error — so the response must literally contain {"status": "ok"} for the footer to read 'API: ok'. The endpoint itself is not implemented in this repository.
